# Overview

A SwiftUI app (iOS and macOS) that brings everything you earn from your apps into a single dashboard, in euros:

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Targets | `RevenueDashboard` (application) |
| Swift package | `Package.swift` (tools 6.0); platforms macOS .v14, iOS .v17 |
| iOS deployment target | `17.0` |
| macOS deployment target | `14.0` |
| Swift language mode | `5.0` |
| SDKs and frameworks | Charts |

Keep this page current when targets, OS versions, languages, or SDKs change.
